title: Bank transfer
overview: Customers transfer funds between owned accounts with confirmation and audit history.
capabilities: Transfer funds between eligible accounts
businessRules: Reject amounts above the available balance
constraints: Complete within 3 seconds and require MFA
acceptanceCriteria: Insufficient balances are rejected with a clear message

title: Password reset
overview: Registered users recover access through a time limited email verification link.
capabilities:
Request a password reset
Set a new password
businessRules: Links expire after 15 minutes and can be used once
constraints: Do not disclose whether an account exists
acceptanceCriteria: Given a valid token when a compliant password is submitted then access is restored

title: Claims intake API
overview: Partners submit insurance claims and retrieve an immutable acknowledgement reference.
capabilities:
Submit a claim
Retrieve claim status
businessRules: Duplicate partner references return the original acknowledgement
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid policies return a structured 422 response

title: Clinic appointments
overview: Patients search clinician availability and reserve or cancel appointments.
capabilities:
Search available appointments
Book an appointment
Cancel an appointment
businessRules: Cancellation is blocked within 2 hours of start
constraints: WCAG 2.2 AA and encrypted local storage
acceptanceCriteria: A slot cannot be booked twice

title: Warehouse ingestion
overview: Nightly orders are validated and loaded into the analytics warehouse with reconciliation.
capabilities:
Validate source files
Load valid records
Reconcile totals
businessRules: Invalid rows are quarantined without blocking valid rows
acceptanceCriteria: Source and target totals must match before publication

title: CRM contact sync
overview: Customer contact changes synchronize from CRM to the support platform.
capabilities: Synchronize changed contacts
businessRules: CRM is the system of record
integrations: CRM REST API; support platform API
acceptanceCriteria: Retries do not create duplicate contacts

title: ERP customer migration
overview: Active customer master records move from the legacy ERP to the new platform.
capabilities:
Transform customer records
Validate reconciliation
Execute rollback
businessRules: Every legacy identifier remains traceable
constraints: Encrypt exports and retain for 30 days
acceptanceCriteria: Record counts and control totals reconcile before cutover

title: Expense approval
overview: Employees submit expenses and managers approve them within delegated limits.
capabilities:
Submit an expense
Approve or reject an expense
businessRules: Receipts are required above 25 dollars
acceptanceCriteria: Managers cannot approve their own expenses

title: Order returns
overview: Customers request eligible returns and receive a tracked shipping label.
capabilities:
Check return eligibility
Create return label
businessRules: Returns close 30 days after delivery
acceptanceCriteria: Ineligible orders show the governing reason

title: Quarterly access review
overview: Managers attest or revoke user access during quarterly certification campaigns.
capabilities:
Review assigned access
Revoke inappropriate access
businessRules: Unreviewed access escalates after 10 days
acceptanceCriteria: A reviewer cannot certify their own privileged access

title: Inventory availability
overview: Sales channels query sellable inventory by product and fulfillment location.
capabilities: Retrieve sellable quantity
businessRules: Reserved stock is excluded
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown products return 404 without internal details

title: Notification preferences
overview: Users choose channels and topics for account notifications while mandatory security messages remain enabled.
capabilities: Update notification preferences
businessRules: Security notifications cannot be disabled
acceptanceCriteria: Unverified channels cannot be enabled

title: Invoice matching
overview: Supplier invoices are matched against purchase orders and goods receipts for payment review.
capabilities:
Match invoice lines
Route exceptions
businessRules: Price variance above 2 percent requires approval
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate invoice numbers are blocked per supplier

title: Device enrollment
overview: Employees enroll managed mobile devices after identity and compliance verification.
capabilities: Enroll a compliant device
businessRules: Rooted or jailbroken devices are denied
acceptanceCriteria: Denied enrollment gives a remediation reason

title: Shipment tracking
overview: Carrier events are normalized into a customer visible shipment timeline.
capabilities:
Ingest tracking events
Display shipment timeline
businessRules: Events are ordered by carrier occurrence time
assumptionsRisks: Events can arrive out of order
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate events are idempotently ignored

title: Consent ledger
overview: Customer consent decisions are recorded with purpose jurisdiction and effective dates.
capabilities:
Record consent
Withdraw consent
View consent history
businessRules: Withdrawal never deletes historical evidence
constraints: Tamper evident audit and least privilege
acceptanceCriteria: Withdrawal takes effect for new processing immediately

title: Catalog search
overview: Buyers search and filter the active product catalog by relevant product attributes.
capabilities:
Search products
Filter search results
businessRules: Inactive products are excluded
acceptanceCriteria: An empty result explains how to broaden the query

title: Loan decision workflow
overview: Underwriters review applications and record a governed approve decline or refer decision.
capabilities:
Review application
Record underwriting decision
businessRules: Declines require an approved reason code
constraints: Segregation of duties and immutable audit
acceptanceCriteria: A user without underwriting authority is denied

title: Backup restore
overview: Operators restore an application database from a verified encrypted backup into an isolated environment.
capabilities:
Validate backup
Restore database
Verify integrity
businessRules: Production data cannot be restored to development
assumptionsRisks: Some restore points may be unavailable
acceptanceCriteria: Integrity checks pass before traffic is enabled

title: Portal usability
overview: The customer portal should provide an easy and user-friendly account experience.
capabilities: View the account overview quickly
businessRules: Use robust security as needed
acceptanceCriteria: The experience should be seamless
